candidate_program.name: local_redundancy_discount
candidate_program.rationale: Discounts redundant blocked reward when competing neighbors conflict with one another, retaining a strongest-neighbor floor. Active one-hop edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree and cannot resolve the saved remote witness.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_edge_mass / max(1, degree)) / (1 + weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
